title: ceuthocarpus involucratus
intro: Ceuthocarpus involucratus, commonly known as the "Buddha's hand plant" or "fingered citron," is a type of citron (Citrus medica) that belongs to the Rutaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include aiding in digestion, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ceuthocarpus involucratus are thought to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, that have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant, and it is primarily used in traditional Chinese medicine for its purported health benefits.
